description: A stereo amplifier reaching 200%, with a CV input and a hard limiter

params.text: Sets the gain applied before any CV is added, 0 to 200%
Scales the LEVEL input, -200% to +200%, and the result is added to the base level
Switches the limiter on, clamping both outputs to the voltage the knob below sets
Sets the voltage the limiter clamps the outputs to, 0 to 10V either side of zero

inputs.text: The left signal to be amplified; the number of channels on this cable sets the number on the outputs unless the LEVEL input carries more than one
The right signal to be amplified
Sets the gain, a fifth of its voltage scaled by the VCA knob and added to the base level, with the total held between 0 and 200%

notes: the outputs are clamped at ±10V even with the limiter switched off; the LIM knob only lowers that ceiling.
menu: Polyphonic OUTs — carries the input polyphony through to the outputs; with it off every channel is summed into a single-channel output

inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
